verdict.rationale: A government service portal could reasonably publish an API spec, so the axis applies. The evidence shows none: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the only programmatic-adjacent feature is QuickFile, a desktop tool that reads a formatted wage-report file rather than a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
